text:
Emma L: Hey team — need an approvals path for an offer exception. Candidate is for Sr SWE, manager signed off on band 5 but recruiting autopick assigned band 4. Candidate is asking to start 4/04 and will walk if we push. Can comp committee or someone with uplift authority route?
Raj P: Can you drop the numbers? base / target / sign-on?
Emma L: Base expected $220k, band4 top is $195k. Hiring manager ok w/ $220k if we can do a one-time catch-up sign-on. Sign-on discussed at $25k. Total comp ~ $245k.
Maria Chen: FYI headcount and budget are available for Q2 but band uplift > standard process. We usually need comp-committee + finance ok for one-time exception.
Derek: If comp-committee can’t meet before 4/04, we can offer a provisional bridge: hire at band4 base + immediate one-time sign-on, with documented promise to move to band5 after committee approval. Needs exec sponsor.
Finance Ops: Bridge plan fine in principle but need the approval doc and cost centre OK. Also prefer start date + payroll enrollment aligned (benefits cutoff 4/01).
Emma L: Cool. Who can sponsor the exec sign-off? Maria any chance to escalate to VP Eng?
Maria Chen: I can escalate to VP Eng (K. Nguyen) now. Will also ping comp-committee for a quick review.
HiringBot: Approval workflow created: #AW-4521. Current status: request submitted -> comp-committee review (pending) -> finance review (pending). Link: https://internal.redwood/approvals/AW-4521
Raj P: @Maria Chen please include a brief justification: rapid hire risk + market comp intel. Also include manager note agreeing to re-eval performance at 6 months.
Maria Chen: Will include. Emma, can you confirm start-date flexibility if committee asks to move to 4/11?
Emma L: Candidate prefers 4/04 but could accept 4/11 if need be. Manager pushing to 4/04 due to sprint kickoff.
Derek: Alternative: offer start 4/04 remote onboarding, formal payroll active 4/11 after benefits cutoff — reduces payroll complications. Need candidate sign-off.
Finance Ops: That split start is OK but we must document pro-rated benefits and payroll effective date. We need to see the offer letter language.
Emma L: Drafting offer now. Adding clause: "start work on 4/04 for onboarding; payroll and benefits effective 4/11" — will send draft.
Maria Chen: Routing note added to AW-4521 with market comps and manager endorsement. Escalating to VP Eng now.
HiringBot: AW-4521 update: comp-committee reviewer assigned (L. Ortiz). Target review ETA: 24 hours.
Raj P: If L. Ortiz approves uplift, finance to confirm funding and we can send offer same day.
Maria Chen: VP Eng responded: "supporting provisional uplift pending committee sign-off. Can approve exec-sponsor stamp once committee votes."
Finance Ops: If committee approves uplift to band5, we need an updated cost center PO number. Maria, please include PO request in AW-4521.
Emma L: Uploaded offer draft to the request. Snippet below: ```Offer #AW-4521
Base: $220,000
Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time)
Band: provisional band5 (committee approval pending)
Start: 2026-04-04 onboarding / 2026-04-11 payroll
```
Derek: Looks good. Add a line: "Band adjustment effective retroactive to payroll start if approved within 60 days."
Emma L: Added.
HiringBot: AW-4521 status -> comp-committee approved by L. Ortiz at 1719876570. Finance review requested.
Finance Ops: Reviewed, funding OK. Approve provisional uplift on condition of final PO. Sending PO request to procurement.
Maria Chen: Procurement confirmed PO 22-ENG-9812 pending final sign-off; added to AW-4521.
Emma L: Great — locking offer. Sending to candidate now.
Emma L: Offer sent, candidate accepted verbally. Will upload signed doc once returned. :tada:
Raj P: :thumbsup: nice work team.
HiringBot: AW-4521 final status: provisional uplift approved, offer sent. Closed pending signed offer and payroll confirmation.
